title: Irreducible improper phi-regret in Lean
summary: A Mathlib-only formalization of two explicit three-action improper phi-regret families in Section 4.4.1 of Dann, Mansour, Mohri, Schneider, and Sivan (COLT 2025). They are finite counterexample families for the paper's rate-preserving linear-reduction program. It proves valid-improper certificates, the affine-hyperplane invariant-transport core of Lemma 4, the extreme-point antipodal-displacement core of Lemma 5, a direct finite one-way affine action/loss-transfer-to-canonical bridge, a source-style two-direction affine linear-equivalence-to-canonical bridge in an explicit…

review.reason: Lean formalization of finite counterexample families for improper phi-regret reduction programs.
